doc: docs/PROCESS-AUDIT-2026-10-21.md sections 3.4 and 5.4. tools/variety.mjs deals ONLY options listed under `approved` (filtered by `modes`), never an option under `blocked`, and never anything unlisted. Evidence is a ledger id (`node tools/ledger.mjs show <id>`) or the founder's own words from knowledge/founder/founder-taste.md. Type voices and dark recipes also carry `blocked` on their own entries in type-voices.json / dark-recipes.json; the picker reads both. To approve an option, add it here with the founder verdict that approved it; to block one, add the reject. A canon page's numbers (system/canon/<kind>.json, key `variety`: {axis: [ids]}) narrow these pools further when present.

type.why: Type voice is not randomised for SaaS heroes and landings: Inter display (opsz) or the brand's own face is the floor (audit 5.4; founder rule: big Inter must be the display cut with opsz; accepted Quorum 58/550, Kestrel 72/550, Kite 68/550). Use --brand-face "<Family>" when the brand owns a face.
